observations: Registration date: PRED-402.F1 is registered 2026-01-26 in deposit 402 (Epistle to the Human Diaspora), but its statement sits in deposit 402's appendix 'body previously seated here — a different work, superseded 2026-10-15', which is the paper 'Render unto the Operator' dated May 24, 2026 (lines 239-301), the same text as its later statement F126.F1 (deposit 126, 2026-05-24). The claim's earliest statement is 2026-05-24, not 2026-01-26.

PRED-939.B2 (group TP45.1: debt recognized when models trained on contaminated corpora degrade) belongs with the same set PRED-95.G1 / PRED-938.G2 (group TP45.3: provenance erasure as the mechanism of model collapse); left separate because it forecasts when the degradation is recognized, not the mechanism.

Apparent contradiction: PRED-87.B1 forecasts that retrieval systems trained on CHA data learn to distinguish the original from the claimant, while PRED-907.G7 hypothesises that retrieval systems treat the well-surfaced derivative as the dominant representation of the original.
PRED-1067.D2 (Phase X Invariance Condition naming training systems) is the only Phase X claim in this batch; the Phase X scope states the protocol names lie in other groups.
PRED-78.E3 carries a 2049 window and 'models trained after 2040' because it is a future-dated fictional TANG entry, not a registration-date error.
